properties.description: Pins req:a-near-match-across-types-or-within-a-line-of-reasoning-is-a-note-not-a-refusal as a class: every checking constructor (add_requirement, add_design_rule, add_capability, add_component, add_decision) against nine other seed types is written, with the match named and typed in search_first.near_matches. Two statements of a proof are written beside each other. A same-type match outside a line of reasoning still refuses with all three answers. And each of proof trial rung 2's 49 statements, re-recorded against the rest of its design with no distinct_from, is written.
properties.name: a_near_match_across_types_or_within_reasoning_is_a_note.rs — the class test for the near-match rule, and the proof trial's 49 statements replayed
